conditional_findings.canonical_owner: The terrain landform preparation outcome tying a scene and recipe to a generated patch or an owned generation error.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: If a requested client landform regeneration fails, the presentation source converts its typed failure to absence before its caller can distinguish that failure from no landform.
conditional_findings.trace: PendingScenes requires SceneId, terrain and environment, and admits optional recipe and optional prepared patch. On the spawn path, spawn_base_and_fault clones a supplied patch or invokes terrain_landform_patch for a present recipe using .ok(), turning any TerrainRecipeError into None. The base mesh and detail mesh still receive the recipe-derived transition collar; the fault mesh is spawned only when both patch and recipe are Some. After material preparation succeeds and subordinate helpers return normally, spawn_presentation returns Ok, present_pending_terrain removes the pending marker and, if timing is present, marks first terrain prepared. This is a source-level control-flow consequence conditional on a failed regeneration, not an observed error or scene.
conditional_findings.admitted_pair_symbolic: A default SceneTerrain is a flat2x2 grid at1m spacing with1m width/depth. Separately, a FaultScarp quantized recipe with AuthoredFixture sandstone Massive surface, origin [10000,0]cm, tangent [10000,0] permyriad, relief600cm, half-length1200cm, half-width1000cm, collar250cm, Detail LOD and any seed passes the inspected independent parameter, positive-length, finite-point and transition-collar bounds; pinned Bevy Dir2 source accepts the finite unit axis. Its aggregate validate checks x origin100m against terrain half-width0.5m plus tangent extent12m and returns OutsidePlayable. This symbolic independently-admissible pair demonstrates an aggregate relationship requiring validation, not an ordinary valid scene or an executed constructor.
conditional_findings.normal_producer_safeguards: TacticalSceneInput::validate_source builds the playable terrain and validates the optional recipe against it; generate_unfurnished generates the patch for the supported terrain and propagates TerrainRecipeError through SceneValidationError::Terrain and SceneInputError. The server generates before spawn and supplies the generated patch locally; the selected netcode registry replicates SceneTerrain and replicate_once TerrainLandformRecipe, and does not list SceneTerrainPatch there. The client source independently regenerates when no prepared patch exists. The inspected city product uses transpose to retain a landform failure. The symbolic invalid pair would be rejected by normal scene validation; no actual replicated mismatch, cross-platform divergence or producer path yielding it has been established.
conditional_findings.safeguards: No constructor, deserializer, generator, scene, network, schedule, renderer, product test or runtime probe was run. Material failure or another helper failure changes the conditional control flow; visibility, holes, observable effects and real client error incidence are unproved. Distinguish a legitimately absent recipe from a failed requested patch, while respecting intentional tactical server authority and topology.
